exposure: Maternal hemodynamics (cardiac index, systemic vascular resistance, stroke volume index)
outcome: Operative delivery due to presumed fetal compromise (Cesarean or instrumental delivery for abnormal fetal heart monitoring)
finding: In women undergoing induction of labor, lower maternal cardiac index and higher systemic vascular resistance were associated with an increased risk of operative delivery due to presumed fetal compromise, and the addition of stroke volume index, systemic vascular resistance, or systemic vascular resistance index improved the predictive accuracy of a baseline model including parity alone.
